stories.title:
A NEW HOME
IN HOMESTEAD?
stories.question:
WOULD YOU
MAKE THE TRIP?
stories.caption:
A new home for Miami FC in Homestead? Here’s the plan.

15,000 stadium seats. An 80-acre sports complex. A $300 million development including training, public sports facilities and a hotel.

Miami FC announced the plans in September 2025 and still lists Homestead as its future stadium. This is the proposal, not an opening announcement. The image is the club-published architectural rendering.

Would you make the trip? Tell us your city.
https://www.miamifc.com/news/2025/09/18/miami-fc-unveils-new-stadium-plans/

#MiamiFC #Homestead #FloridaSoccer #SupportYourLocalClub
stories.altText: Animated explainer of Miami FC’s planned Homestead stadium, using its official architectural rendering and crest. Graphics show 15,000 planned seats, 80 acres and a $300 million full development with training, public sports facilities and a hotel. This is a future plan, not an open stadium. Generic synthetic narration and original music accompany the graphics.

narration.text: Miami F C is planning a new home in Homestead.
A fifteen thousand seat stadium, in an eighty acre sports complex.
The three hundred million dollar plan also includes training, recreation and a hotel.
A future home for Miami F C, right here in South Florida.
